title: Shade Slick Hydrating Tinted Lip Oil

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fragrance Free✓ High Shine Finish✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A lightweight tinted lip oil that gives a wash of moisturizing color with a high-shine finish for hydrated, healthy lips.

Formulation Type: Lip Gloss

Benefits: Hydrating

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Rosehip Oil and Omega-3, 6, and 9 Essential Fatty Acids: Support healthy barrier function and provide beneficial antioxidants.
- Shea Butter and Grapeseed Oil: Condition and soften.
- Jojoba Oil: Forms a protective barrier to lock in moisture.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This non-sticky lip oil glides on smoothly, giving a sheer wash of color with a high-shine finish.

Clean at Sephora
Our commitment to offe
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Swipe onto lips for a sheer wash of color and moisture.
-Wear alone or paired with your favorite MERIT Signature Lip lipstick and liner (sold separately).
